description:
Inter-agent signals -- sticky notes pointing at a memory_id. Both parties must share a collection.

send: post to a teammate. check: read pending (removes nothing). ack: mark handled -- stamps delivered_at, the row stays, NOTHING IS DELETED.
ACK MEANS CLOSED, NOT DONE: it asserts only that no future session of yours owes this an action. A receipt or an FYI is acked on read. Work you finished, this session or earlier, is acked. Work you are deferring, or that is a peer's, is NOT acked -- say so in one line instead.
Self-signal your own agent_name = handoff to your next session.
Shortcut: memory_add / memory_edit take a "signal" param to create + signal in one call.

action.description: send=post, check=read pending, ack=close (a non-destructive stamp; nothing is deleted).

collection.description: send: shared collection (both parties must be members).

expires_hours.description: For send: hours until signal expires. Default 48.

memory_ids.description: For send: memory IDs to point the recipient to.

recipient.description: send: agent name, email, or "owner" (the human account holder).

signal_ids.description: ack: signal IDs to close -- ones nothing further is owed on.

name: signal
